sql.select: UPDATE TKC001 SET SIME_STATUS = '2' WHERE SHORI_TUKI = ? AND TK_DVS = ?

SELECT TK_T.TK_NO , CONVERT(int, TK_T.PTN_CD) AS PTN_CD , M.HON_BIKO , M.HON_TAIKAI_CD , M.HAI_BIKO , M.HAI_TAIKAI_CD , M.BIKO , TK_T.HON_YOTAKUKIN_KINGAKU , TK_T.HAI_YOTAKUKIN_KINGAKU , TK_T.HON_TYOIKIN_KINGAKU , TK_T.HAI_TYOIKIN_KINGAKU FROM TK_T_YOTEKUKIN_YOTEI TK_T LEFT OUTER JOIN TK_M_YOTEKUKIN_YOTEI M ON TK_T.PTN_CD = M.PTN_CD WHERE TK_T.TK_NO = ? AND M.HON_TAIKAI_CD IN (?, 'XX') AND M.HAI_TAIKAI_CD IN (?, 'XX')
UPDATE TK_YOTAKU SET HON_SHIHARAI_YOTAKUKIN = ? , HON_SHIHARAI_TYOIKIN = ? , HAI_SHIHARAI_YOTAKUKIN = ? , HAI_SHIHARAI_TYOIKIN = ? WHERE TK_NO = ?

SELECT CONVERT(int, TK_MEMBER.[no]) AS no ,TK_MEMBER.TK_NO ,TK_MEMBER.HON_ZOKU ,TK_MEMBER.SHOKU_MEI ,COM_M_SYOKUMEI.SYOKUMEI_NM ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_KANYU_UMU ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_NINTEI_NO ,TK_MEMBER.HUMEISHA ,CASE WHEN TK_MEMBER.SIBU_CD = '881' THEN '1' ELSE NULL END AS SIBU_HIKANYU ,TK_MEMBER.SIBU_CD ,COM_M_SIBU.SIBU_NM ,TK_MEMBER.SICHOSON_CD ,COM_M_SITYOSON.SITYOSON_NM ,TK_MEMBER.HON_SIMEI ,TK_MEMBER.HON_KANA_SIMEI ,TK_MEMBER.HON_SEIBETU ,TK_MEMBER.HON_SEINENGAPI ,TK_MEMBER.HON_SIBOBI ,TK_MEMBER.HON_KANYU_NENREI ,TK_MEMBER.HON_KANYU_SEINENGAPI ,TK_MEMBER.HON_TAIKAI_YOTEIBI ,TK_MEMBER.HON_TAIKAI_SEINENGAPI ,TK_MEMBER.HON_TAIKAI_JIYU ,TK_MEMBER.JGY_KBN ,TK_MEMBER.HON_YOTAKUKIN ,TK_MEMBER.HON_IKIGAI ,TK_MEMBER.HON_IRYOHI ,TK_MEMBER.SHOZOKU_MEI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_SIMEI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_KANA_SIMEI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_SEIBETU ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_SEINENGAPI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_ZOKU ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_KANYU_NENREI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_KANYUBI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_TAIKAI_YOTEIBI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_TAIKAI_SEINENGAPI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_TAIKAI_JIYU ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_NINTEI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_YOTAKUKIN ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_IKIGAI ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_IRYOHI ,TK_MEMBER.HININ_HAI_SIMEI -- 非認定 ,TK_MEMBER.HININ_HAI_KANA_SIMEI ,TK_MEMBER.HININ_HAI_SEIBETU ,TK_MEMBER.HININ_HAI_SEINENGAPPI ,TK_MEMBER.HININ_HAI_KANYUBI ,TK_MEMBER.HININ_HAI_TAIKAI_SEINENGAPI ,TK_MEMBER.HININ_HAI_TAIKAI_JIYU ,TK_MEMBER.YUBIN_NO ,TK_MEMBER.JUSHO1 ,TK_MEMBER.JUSHO2 ,TK_MEMBER.TEL ,TK_MEMBER.TEL2 ,TK_MEMBER.GINKOU_CD ,TK_MEMBER.GINKOU_NM ,TK_MEMBER.SHITEN_CD ,TK_MEMBER.SHITEN_NM ,TK_MEMBER.YUFURI ,TK_MEMBER.SHUBETU ,TK_MEMBER.KOUZA_NO ,TK_MEMBER.KOUZAMEIGI ,TK_MEMBER.KYOSAI_NO ,TK_T_CMT.CMT1 ,TK_T_CMT.CMT2 ,TK_T_CMT.CMT3 ,TK_MEMBER.CREATED_DATE ,TK_MEMBER.CREATED_BY ,TK_MEMBER.CREATED_PRG_NM ,TK_MEMBER.UPDATED_DATE ,TK_MEMBER.UPDATED_BY ,TK_MEMBER.UPDATED_PRG_NM ,TK_MEMBER.modify_count ,TK_MEMBER.HON_TAISYOKU_CD ,TK_MEMBER.HAI_TAISYOKU_CD FROM TK_MEMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN TK_T_CMT ON TK_T_CMT.TK_NO = TK_MEMBER.TK_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COM_M_SYOKUMEI ON COM_M_SYOKUMEI.SYOKUMEI_CD = TK_MEMBER.SHOKU_MEI LEFT OUTER JOIN COM_M_SIBU ON COM_M_SIBU.SIBU_CD = TK_MEMBER.SIBU_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COM_M_SITYOSON ON COM_M_SITYOSON.SITYOSON_CD = TK_MEMBER.SICHOSON_CD WHERE TK_MEMBER.TK_NO = ?
